key_findings: Osteoking promotes rat tibial fracture healing, accompanied by reduced EGF/p-EGFR/HDAC1 and activated Wnt/β-catenin signaling.
Osteoking raised VEGFA, OSX, CD31 and RUNX2/PPARγ ratio and lowered RANKL/OPG ratio.
